summary: Comprehensive testing of compliance rebrand (Iteration 5 -> private business, Govt-approved rooftop solar vendor). Backend: 8/8 new compliance tests + previous regression suite unaffected. Frontend: verified home hero + CTAs + Vacancies preview + calculator disclaimer + SchemesInfo cards + Enquiry form end-to-end (POST /api/enquiry -> ENQ-xxxxxxxx ref shown) + Services (6 correct cards + compliance note + card->/enquiry nav) + About disclaimer + all 8 route redirects (/login, /register, /solar/apply, /loan/apply, /dashboard, /csc, /irrigation, /status) + Footer tagline & links. No login/register/dashboard/admin reachable through UI. No 'Apply Now' anywhere on home. Screenshot confirms Hindi & English work cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still contains dead auth code (register/login/session/logout/me, password reset, /admin/* endpoints) even though UI no longer routes to them. Consider gating admin endpoints behind an env flag or moving auth routes to a separate `auth_router.py` and only including it when ENABLE_ADMIN=true, to reduce public attack surface for a compliance-first site.
server.py is 1221 lines — split into routers (enquiry, vacancies, admin, farming). Currently violates the file-size guideline.

Old models (SolarApplicationIn, LoanApplicationIn, IrrigationApplicationIn, CSCRequestIn) still accept aadhaar_number / pan_number. Even though the UI no longer submits these, the endpoints /api/solar/apply, /api/loan/apply, /api/csc/apply, /api/irrigation/apply are still live and will happily persist Aadhaar & PAN if called directly. For strict compliance, either (a) remove those routes entirely, or (b) strip aadhaar_number/pan_number fields from those Pydantic models.

/api/downloads seed still references 'PM Surya Ghar Application Form', 'Solar Subsidy Guidelines', 'Loan Application Checklist' with url='#'. If shown in UI, this may create the impression that Haryana Enterprises processes government subsidy applications — please verify Downloads page copy adds an 'informational only, verify with mnre.gov.in' disclaimer.

IRRIGATION_SCHEMES dict hard-codes subsidy % ('70%-85%', 'Up to 85%'); this contradicts the loan-info 'no guarantee' policy. If /irrigation page is now removed from UI (redirect -> /services), consider removing this stale data.
Enquiry endpoint has no rate limiting — could be spam-abused. Recommend adding a simple per-IP rate limit (slowapi) since it's a public unauthenticated endpoint.
Enquiry model lacks a 'source'/'referrer' field which would help attribute leads (nice-to-have).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (24/24 home checks + 6/6 services + enquiry submit success + about disclaimer + 8/8 redirects + all footer checks). One transient locator timeout was retried & passed; one test-script selector prefix mismatch (vacancy-card- vs actual vacancy-preview-card-) — visually confirmed in screenshot that vacancy cards DO render on home.
